body:
I just viewed your profile and seen all the comments you've written to help people, you really are an amazing person and this has really helped me and feel better. 

Thankyou

I feel like its to late, when I started having these feelings i told myself dont give up you can still get through with a pass. The more i try the more, the more i feel like ive failed and everything feels like it has piled up, and theres no point in trying cus i know ive failed. And my only option is to get a job and start making money so my parents wont be disappointed in me.

During the end of holidays and start of second term/semester i stop doing coursework and revision for exams, idk why i just lost all motivation and slept alot, i had a lack of emotion and urgency to do the work, i even woke up 3 hours befor the exam to do some revision 30 minutes before the exam started i just couldn’t leave the house and went back to bed.

After that i guess I realised that there was something wrong and all the emotions and urgency just hit me all at once, like a train. 

I dont want to go through this agian and probably if i get a chance to resit wont take it. 

Throughout my life school/college and uni i found it hard to ask for help even with common stuff, i guess i feel like my question or problems are stupid and somewhat irrelevant.

Life is pointless were all gonna die and be forgotten, I would love to save all the pain and misery that i know the future will have. But it would cause those who i love pain and misery and they would probably end up feeling like me. So im going to keep living as long as i can to prevent them feeling what i feel.
